title: Self-Ballasted LED Lamps for General Lighting Services — Part 1: Safety Requirements
qco_name: Self-Ballasted LED Lamps (Quality Control) Mandatory Order
source_authority: Bureau of Indian Standards / MeitY Gazette

clauses.title: Lamp Cap Interchangeability and B22d / E27 Dimensions
clauses.text: Clause 6.1 (Cap Dimensions): LED lamp caps (B22d bayonet or E27 edison screw) shall conform to IS 9249 / IEC 60061-1 gauges. Creepage distance and clearance between cap contacts and accessible metal parts shall not be less than 5.0 mm.

clauses.title: Insulation Resistance and Electric Strength Withstand
clauses.text: Clause 8.1 (Dielectric Electric Strength): Insulation resistance between current-carrying parts and accessible enclosure shall be min 4.0 MΩ. High voltage test: 4000 V AC (rms) applied for 1 minute without breakdown.
